config.fallback: feature-space OOD (full gate features) OR outside the convex hull of the training regions

verdict.conclusion: Acceptance is met numerically only by the deployed multi gate: at noise 0.15 it reaches 0.969 vs geometry(0.25) 0.829 and hybrid_diag 0.859, but this is within 0.003 of the tuned fixed dead zone (0.972) and does not exceed it. The deployed binary gate is 0.830 (+0.001 over geo0.25), essentially geometry(0.25). No no-fallback learned gate beats geo0.25 (binary 0.614, multi 0.644 vs 0.829). The gate fits A/B/C validation almost perfectly but does not transfer to D/G because the learned head is OOD-broken on vertical-aligned / unseen-coordinate pairs. The OOD fallback is necessary for safety, but the only safe performance gain is a wider/adaptive geometric dead zone. E3's hybrid_diag advantage at tau=0.25 is an under-tuned-dead-zone artifact.
